The IaC template sets it to !Ref OutputBucket (lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi), so the live value deviates from the intended state. It was modified at 00:26:58Z, just before the window. Throughout the window, the Thumbnailer logs show repeated NoSuchBucket errors on s3 PutObject (handler.py line 43), so every thumbnail write fails. The IAM policy (s3:PutObject on the output bucket) and the other functions' configs match the template, so the fault is a configuration change, not IAM, IaC or code.
